title: Aromatic Spicy Saudi Arabian Serrano Ham Kebabs
description: A pungent and snappy Saudi Arabian dish featuring serrano ham and bhuna, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is low-fat-friendly and full of flavor. It combines the spices of Saudi Arabia with the savory taste of serrano ham.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the serrano ham, onion, bell pepper, and garlic onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the bhuna spice mix, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to create a marinade.
Brush the marinade onto the kebabs, making sure they are fully coated.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and the serrano ham is crispy.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and squeeze the lemon juice over them.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
